core_meaning.primary_meaning: Madih is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Praiser, one who praises”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Madih corresponds to the Arabic form مادح (Arabic root م د ح (m-d-ḥ); مَادِح (Mādiḥ)). Its core sense is praiser, one who praises. Madih is Arabic مَادِح (Mādiḥ) 'praiser, one who praises', from the root م د ح (m-d-ḥ). CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave مدیح, using Persian letters in the Arabic column. The source gloss 'Praise, Glory' is broadly consistent. Same name as madeeha, madiha and madihah.

persian.name: مادح

hindi.name: मादिह

arabic.name: مادح
